items.headline: All-India House Price Index for Q1:2026-27
items.what_happened: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) compiles the House Price Index (HPI) on a quarterly basis using transaction-level data received from the registration authorities. Today, the RBI released 1 the HPI for Q1:2026-27 with base year as 2022-23, covering eighteen major cities 2 . Highlights: The All India HPI increased by 1.1 per cent and stood at 117.5 in Q1:2026-27 compared to previous quarter, primarily driven by an increase in the index for cities such as Chandigarh, Lucknow, and Thiruvananthapuram ( Chart 1 ).
